input.subject: Formal refund request and potential legal dispute — contract breach
input.textPlain: I am writing to formally request a full refund of $24,000 for the Q1 engagement. We believe the deliverables did not meet the contractual SLA and our legal counsel has advised we may pursue a breach-of-contract claim. Please respond within 7 business days with your position. This is a formal legal notice.
